cohort: The study participants consisted of eighteen mother-neonate pairs from whom fecal metagenomes were isolated.
finding: A core set of specific antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) and virulence determinants were detected in both mothers and their infants, persisting across multiple stages up to 12 months, predominantly carried by Bacillota, Pseudomonadota, and Actinomycetota, and associated with mobile genetic elements.
